title: A practical one-pot synthesis of dehydroalanine esters
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9359-9363
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00035A, Paper

Qingyuan Shi, Mengxiao Zhu, Zhenchu Liang, Xu Dong, Minyue Zhang, Lili Yang, Pingping Sun, Chuanyi Xing, Xiaohao Zha, Fei Li, Hongliang He, Dongyin Chen
A practical one-pot synthesis of various dehydroalanine esters was realized via a Cs2CO3-mediated simultaneous esterification/elimination process, starting from commercially available N-protected serines and various haloalkanes.
